title: Dispatch: implement F-09 A4 (retire adjudication context; tool-description facts)
description:
Implement F-09 design amendment A4 (docs/design/rule-record-runtime-statements.md, "Amendment A4", committed 122c239c on integration branch eshyra-o9bd.19.3.4.4 — read it first; it is the authority). User decision 2026-09-30: retire the adjudication-context channel and move tool-contract facts into the tools' own descriptions. Known limits (A3 criteria) stay exactly as they are.

Worktree/branch: .worktrees/eshyra-o9bd.19.3.4.4.7 on branch eshyra-o9bd.19.3.4.4.7, cut from eshyra-o9bd.19.3.4.4 @ 122c239c. `npm ci` first.

## 1. Retire the channel completely (no dead code, no silent stubs)
Remove every trace of the adjudication-context channel. Known files (re-grep `adjudicationContext|AdjudicationContext|ruleAdjudicationContext|RULE_ADJUDICATION_CONTEXT|adjudication context` to be sure):
- delete packages/core/src/rules/ruleAdjudicationContext.ts (and any export of it from src/internal.ts / src/index.ts);
- src/rules/ruleAwareness.ts: RuleStatements / RuleAwareness / injectable datasets lose adjudicationContext;
- src/discovery/types.ts, packet.ts, packetMessage.ts: the packet candidate field and the "### Eshyra adjudication context" rendering go;
- src/orchestrator/toolLookupRules.ts: adjust any envelope/description wording that names the channel;
- packages/core/scripts/create-dnd5e-srd-audit-bundle/ruleDispositions.ts + cli.ts: RuleProcedureCoverage drops adjudicationContext; materializer, validateRuleRegistries, buildRuleDispositionReport and the GameplayReadinessReport count/format only implementation + knownLimits (+ no-runtime-statement). Keep the 175-key set.
- tests (ruleDispositions.test.ts, rules/ruleAwareness.test.ts, tools.test.ts, anything else): delete tests whose only subject is the retired channel; ADAPT (don't delete) tests that also protect something that survives — e.g. the synthetic channel-independence test becomes capability + two known limits; the real-materializer dual-channel test becomes implementation + two known limits; every known-limit assertion (suffocation, exhaustion trio, knockout, action:ready, conflict, special weapons, weapon properties, deferred rows, 8-word overlap test over known limits) must remain. The 8-word overlap test keeps running over known limits.
- Known-limit R0 comments that point at the retired dataset ("see RULE_ADJUDICATION_CONTEXT…") are reworded to stand alone.

## 2. Tool descriptions — add these facts, verbatim unless the code contradicts them
Each was verified by the supervisor against the implementation; re-confirm against the code as you edit, and if any sentence is wrong, STOP and record it on this bead rather than improvising.
- packages/core/src/orchestrator/toolResolveCheck.ts — append to the description (before `args:` or after, keeping `args:` last if that is the file's convention): "vs is a single number: a bonus to the target's AC or DC (for example cover) goes into vs, while modifiers apply only to the roller. To compare against a total that is already fixed (for example a hider's retained Stealth check), pass that total as vs."
- toolResolveContest.ts — append: "Both sides always roll. When one side's total is already fixed (for example a hider's retained Stealth check against a later search), use resolve_check with that total as vs instead."
- toolAddCondition.ts — after "Add a condition to a character.": "Characters only: for an encounter combatant, use update_combatant addCondition." After the no-op sentence: "Because it is a no-op on an existing id, it cannot raise a graded condition: add exhaustion with its level (1-6); a later level increase cannot be recorded with this tool."
- toolRemoveCondition.ts — "Remove a condition from a character by id (characters only: for an encounter combatant, use update_combatant removeCondition). No-op if the condition is not present."
- toolAdjustHp.ts — after the first sentence: "Characters only: for an encounter combatant, use update_combatant hpDelta."
- toolUpdateCombatant.ts — append: "An hpDelta that brings the combatant to 0 hit points sets its status to dead unless status is also passed (for example \"unconscious\" for a nonlethal knockout); combatants have no dying or death-save state."
Permanent evidence (one test in tools.test.ts near the existing description checks): each of these six descriptions contains its target-domain / contract sentence. These protect model-facing tool contracts that six review cycles showed are easy to lose.

## 3. Verify
npm run verify:worktree (all green, no budget changes in discovery probes). If a discovery probe/intervention test asserted adjudication-context content, adapt it to the surviving channels and say so.

## Completion notes (bd update --append-notes)
Files removed/changed; every test deleted vs adapted, with a one-line reason each; the six description diffs; final audit report counts; verify result. Do not touch docs/design/*, importer/pack files, or the known-limit statements' text (comments only).
